Movement for UW 2014 = 148,474 - 151,886 = -3,412 (release)
Movement for UW 2015 = 122,465 - 97,342 = +25,123 (strengthening)
Total Gross Prior Year Development = -3,412 + 25,123 = +21,711 USD '000.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of USD 21.711 million, representing 10.68% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle, showing a release for the 2014 underwriting year and a strengthening for the 2015 underwriting year. General factors contributing to reserve uncertainty and potential adverse development include unforeseen loss trends from court rulings, changes in law, differences in loss adjustment practice, medical and long-term care costs, and economic factors such as inflation.
raw_causal_phrases: Unforeseen loss trends resulting from court rulings, changes in the law, differences in loss adjustment practice, medical and long-term care, and economic factors such as inflation can have a considerable impact on run-off results.
The estimation of reserves is subject to uncertainty due to the fact that the settlement of claims that have arisen before the balance sheet date is dependent on future events and developments.

The uncertainty associated with the ultimate claims experience of an underwriting year is greatest when the underwriting year is at an early stage of development and the margin for future experience potentially being more adverse than assumed is at its highest.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2015 and prior, as the narrative text on page 12 provides a net figure that also includes the 2016 underwriting year, which is still in early development.
